# The heraldry library

Every emoji a bead's arms may hold (spec [`2026-10-25-heraldry-design.md`](../superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-heraldry-design.md) R2-R4). The validator's table is `kbeads/internal/heraldry/library.go`, generated by the same tool from the same inputs as this page.

## Source

- Artwork: [Noto Emoji](https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji) release `v2026-09-24-unicode18_0`, the 72 px PNGs in `2D/png/72` (images Apache 2.0).
- Names and presentation: Unicode `emoji-test.txt` version 18.0 (https://www.unicode.org/Public/18.0.0/emoji/emoji-test.txt).
- Theme glyphs: `gardenio/controller/internal/bridge/theme.go`, the `Garden` and `Business` themes.

| Noto assets that are not an emoji on their own (digits, #, *, regional indicators) | 42 |

Only single-codepoint base emoji are charges (R2): a charge is one grapheme, and a VS16 selector is part of its charge. Anything that takes several codepoints (ZWJ, keycap, flag, tag and skin-tone sequences) is out of v1.

## Exclusions

### Theme glyphs (R4)

The bridge theme already gives these a meaning on Slack cards, so a shield may not hold them. A test in kbeads (`TestThemeExclusionsMatchTheme`) reads `theme.go` and fails when this list drifts.
